items.source: as of 6.2.13: not necessary anymore due to getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class)
items.translation: 自 6.2.13 版本起：由于存在getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class)，已不再必要。

items.source: Given a synthetic bridge Method returns the Method being bridged. A bridge method may be created by the compiler when extending a parameterized type whose methods have parameterized arguments. During runtime invocation the bridge Method may be invoked and/or used via reflection. When attempting to locate annotations on Methods, it is wise to check for bridge Methods as appropriate and find the bridged Method.
items.translation: 给定一个合成bridge Method，它返回被桥接的Method。当扩展具有参数化参数的泛型类型时，编译器可能会创建桥接方法。在运行时调用期间，可以通过反射调用和/或使用该桥接Method。在尝试定位Methods上的注解时，适当检查桥接Methods并找到被桥接的Method是明智的。

items.source: It is safe to call this method passing in a non-bridge Method instance. In such a case, the supplied Method instance is returned directly to the caller. Callers are not required to check for bridging before calling this method.
items.translation: 传入非桥接Method实例调用此方法是安全的。在这种情况下，提供的Method实例将直接返回给调用者。调用方在调用此方法前无需检查桥接情况。

items.source: This is effectively a combination of ClassUtils.getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class) and findBridgedMethod(Method), resolving the original method even if no bridge method has been generated at the same class hierarchy level (a known difference between the Eclipse compiler and regular javac).
items.translation: 这实际上是 ClassUtils.getMostSpecificMethod(Method, Class) 和 findBridgedMethod(Method) 的组合，即使在同一类层次结构级别上未生成桥接方法，也会解析原始方法（这是 Eclipse 编译器与常规 javac 之间的一个已知差异）。

items.source: See The Java Language Specification for more details on the use of bridge methods.
items.translation: 有关桥接方法使用的更多详细信息，请参阅Java 语言规范。

items.source: Compare the signatures of the bridge method and the method which it bridges. If the parameter and return types are the same, it is a 'visibility' bridge method introduced in Java 6 to fix JDK-6342411.
items.translation: 比较桥接方法与它所桥接的方法的签名。如果参数和返回类型相同，则这是一个在 Java 6 中引入以修复 JDK-6342411 的“可见性”桥接方法。

items.source: bridgeMethod - the method to introspect against its declaring class
items.translation: bridgeMethod - 要对其声明类进行内省的方法

items.source: bridgeMethod - the method to introspect against the given target class
items.translation: bridgeMethod - 要针对给定目标类进行内省的方法

items.source: targetClass - the target class to find the most specific method on
items.translation: targetClass - 要查找最具体方法的目标类

items.source: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Phillip Webb

items.source:
the original method (either the bridged method or the passed-in method
if no more specific one could be found)
items.translation: 原始方法（如果找不到更具体的方法，则为桥接方法或传入的方法）

items.source:
the most specific method corresponding to the given bridge method
(can be the original method if no more specific one could be found)
items.translation: 与给定桥接方法最具体的对应方法（如果找不到更具体的方法，则为原始方法）

items.source: Find the local original method for the supplied bridge Method.
items.translation: 查找为提供的bridge 方法指定的本地原始方法。

items.source: Determine the most specific method for the supplied bridge Method in the given class hierarchy, even if not available on the local declaring class.
items.translation: 确定给定类层次结构中最具体的方法，即使该方法在本地声明类中不可用，也适用于提供的 bridge Method。
